en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with tall historic buildings. On the right is an ornate Renaissance/Baroque-style palace façade with a richly decorated portal and balcony; further along is another grand building. A few pedestrians walk along the street and distant mountains rise in the background. The caption at the bottom edge reads in German: "TRIENT, PALAST SARDAGNA MIT POSTGEBÄUDE."
